# Security Standard

## Purpose

Define organization-wide security expectations for routed engineering work.

## Scope

- Applies to design, implementation, review, and operational workflows.
- Captures security ownership and review boundaries.
- Avoids duplicating technology-specific security procedures.

## Ownership

- Primary owner: security and platform maintainers.
- Reviewers: capability owners and repository maintainers.

## Review Process

- Validate that the standard stays policy-oriented.
- Keep requirements concise and easy to reference.
- Avoid adding product-specific or language-specific procedures here.

## Future Content

- Identity and access expectations.
- Secret handling expectations.
- Audit and traceability expectations.
- Security review checkpoints.
